title: fix(app-shell): a record form opened on the app-name address stays in the app after save
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_
Fixes #28036

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：整页记录表单在保存/取消后"要不要后退"的判断，改为读 react-router 自己写在浏览器历史里的条目序号（`history.state.idx`）：只有控制台自己推入过页面（序号大于 0）才后退，否则编辑落到记录页、新建落到列表页，都在应用内。
- **为什么改**：用应用名地址（`/apps/showcase_app/...`）打开表单时，控制台加载时会用一次"替换"把地址换成包 id 地址，这次替换给条目生成了新 key，旧判断（key 不是 `default` 就后退）误以为身后有应用内页面，保存后后退出了应用、提示也丢了。替换不改序号，推入才加一，所以序号能分清这两种情况。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `RecordFormPage` 的 `goBack` 一处判断，不碰 `AppContent.tsx` 的重定向。从列表、视图、记录页进入表单的路径仍然后退（单测与实栈对照都测了）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx` 的 `goBack`；`RecordFormPage.aliasAddressReturn-28036.test.tsx`；`ui/e2e/live/record-form-direct-url.spec.ts` 的新循环。
- **两分钟验证**：看本 PR 的 `Live E2E UI` 检查日志，`Run the live e2e specs` 里 `record-form-direct-url.spec.ts` 应有两条通过：package id 与 app name 各一条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`RecordFormPage`'s `goBack`** (`@object-ui/app-shell`). It went Back when `location.key !== 'default'`. The console's canonical-app-pathname effect replaces an app-NAME address with the package-id one on load, and that `replace` gives the entry a generated key with nothing of the console's behind it, so Save and Cancel ran `navigate(-1)` out of the document (#27454's fix held only on the package-id address). The page now reads react-router's own entry index, `history.state.idx`, at the moment of the click: react-router writes 0 on the entry the document loaded on, keeps it on a replace and adds one per push. Back only when it is a number above 0; otherwise the record detail (edit) or the object list (create), inside the app, as before. `useLocation` is no longer needed by the page and is dropped. Why the index rather than a console-written `location.state` flag: the index is already written by every push the console makes, through any component, and kept by every replace, so nothing else in the console has to remember to mark its navigations; a flag would need every pushing call site to set it.
- **jsdom tests.** New `RecordFormPage.aliasAddressReturn-28036.test.tsx` loads the form on an app-name address under `BrowserRouter` on jsdom's real history, replays the console's canonical `replace` to the package-id address, and asserts edit Save lands on the record detail with one toast, create Save lands on the list with one toast, edit Cancel lands on the record detail with no toast, and the control: a form PUSHED from a view page, then canonicalised, goes Back to that view. Each cell also asserts the replace minted a non-`default` key, the condition the old test misread. `RecordFormPage.directUrlReturn-27454.test.tsx` keeps its five cells and assertions; its harness moves from `MemoryRouter` to `BrowserRouter` with a real react-router push, because the page now reads the browser history's entry index, which a memory router does not write.
- **Live spec.** `ui/e2e/live/record-form-direct-url.spec.ts` now runs its edit case on both addresses (`com.example.showcase` and `showcase_app`); the landing assertion is the package-id record path for both. Its header says why both.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28036-record-form-app-name-address.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage` (from `ui/`): 11 files, 65 tests passed (head `71c89ea2`).
- Ablation, under `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob `4cf71998` to `e207c822`, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty): `goBack`'s condition put back to the old key test (`history.state.key` not `default`). Direction written before the run: the three app-name cells RED, the in-app control GREEN, the five #27454 cells GREEN. Observed: exactly that, 3 failed / 6 passed of 9. Run on `93e6b790` and again on `71c89ea2`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc` programs, the test one included): exit 0 on `71c89ea2`.
- `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:e2e`: exit 0. eslint on the four changed files: 0 errors; the 17 warnings are in lines of `RecordFormPage.tsx` this diff does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's table, re-measured** on this branch (head `1de7cdda`; the later commit changes only the jsdom test harness), with the `Live E2E UI` job's build (its turbo filters plus `VITE_BASE_PATH=/ vite build`), `start-backend.sh` and `vite preview`, one fresh Playwright page per row:

  | Address | Mode | `history.state` after load | URL after Save | Toasts |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `showcase_app` (app name) | edit | key generated, `idx` 0 | record detail, in app | 1 |
  | `showcase_app` (app name) | new | key generated, `idx` 0 | object list, in app | 1 |
  | `com.example.showcase` (package id) | edit | `idx` 0 | record detail, in app | 1 |
  | `com.example.showcase` (package id) | new | `idx` 0 | object list, in app | 1 |
  | `com.example.showcase`, control: pushed from the list | edit | `idx` 1 | object list (Back), in app | 1 |

  The app-name rows read `about:blank` and 0 toasts on #28034's stack before this change (the card's table). The new rows came from a throwaway Playwright file, not committed. The control row's push was written the way react-router's own push writes it (`pushState` with `idx` + 1, then the `popstate` its listener reads), because no showcase object declares `editMode: 'page'`, so the console's Edit and New open the modal form and no in-app control there pushes the full-page form; the jsdom control drives a real react-router push.
- `pnpm --dir ui run test:e2e:live:ci --retries 0` on the same stack: 16 passed (1.5 min on a shared box), the 15 before plus the new app-name case.
- Not changed, noted: `FormPage.tsx` in `ui/apps/console` reads `location.key !== 'default'` for its Cancel, the same test this PR replaces; whether a canonical replace reaches its routes was not measured, and it is outside this card's file surface. `PageHeader` in `ui/packages/layout` still reads `window.history.length > 1` for its back button.
- `console/AppContent.tsx` is untouched (seat 4's open PR #27907 holds it).
- The project attribution link in the first two lines names the seat's thread, as the order requires.
